body.x: Wifi coffee machine by SmarterSmarter (www.smarter.am), a British company which specializes in developing products for connected living, showcased Smarter Coffee at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

Smarter Coffee is the world’s first bean-to-cup, wifi-enabled coffee machine. With this, users can program the coffee to be made without having to be in the same space. It even features a bean-to-cup grinder for fresher coffee. It is controllable from free iOS and Android apps.Smarter Coffee perfectly works with IFTTT, a connector app named after the acronym for the basic logic concept "If This Then That." For example, if your fitness tracker notices a bad nights sleep, Smarter will recommend a stronger coffee when you wake up.
